title: SSC CHSL Tier 1 — 03 Aug 2023 (Shift 4)
subTitle: Official Previous Year Paper (5:15 PM - 6:15 PM)

questions.questionText:
Choose the correct meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence.
The orchard was a peaceful retreat, with the sound of leaves rustling in the wind and
birds chirping in the trees.
options: A piece of land with lots of houses
A piece of enclosed land with fruit trees
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (D).

questions.questionText:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
Make up one’s mind
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (C).

questions.questionText:
Select the grammatically correct version of the following sentence.
I like my puppies, Mac and Matt, but I like Matt best.
options: I like my puppies, Mac and Matt, but I like Matt better.
I like my puppies, Mac and Matt, but I like Matt the best.
I like my puppies, Mac and Matt, but I like Matt much.
I like my puppies, Mac and Matt, but I like Matt most.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (A).

questions.questionText:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase in the following
sentence.
As the actors gathered backstage, the director shouted, “Break a leg, everyone!”
before they took the stage for their opening night performance.
options: To get a good night's sleep
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (B).

questions.questionText:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges
the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.
A) about all his
B) noise they make
C) he constantly complains
D) neighbours and the
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (B).

questions.questionText:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.
I was kept waiting for more than an hour to get an appointment by the staff.
options: The staff had kept me waiting for more than an hour to get an appointment.
The staff keep me waiting for more than an hour to get an appointment.
The staff kept me waiting for more than an hour to get an appointment.
The staff kept me wait for more than an hour to get an appointment.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (C).

questions.questionText:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that
arranges the sentences in the correct logical sequence to form a meaningful and
coherent paragraph.
A. Globally, almost 6.5 million people have died so far.
B. As I write the final chapter, we enter the third year in our battle with COVID-19.
C. While we have the vaccine to outlive the disease, to live our grief needs the salve of
time.
D. I started writing this book in the throes of the pandemic.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (B).
